openings:

Its lead lines are PR and content, the hours the KJ6 read says the agency middle loses; it carries a private equity growth mandate and publishes no pricing. It is likely, moderate confidence, that a rival with a transparent, outcome priced PR and content offer (placements, citations, pipeline) wins mid market tech buyers repricing agency hours. A rival with an audited AI visibility product likely outsells it on the citation question its PR clients will ask under KJ1, though the September 2026 AI posts suggest it is building toward that line (roughly even chance, low confidence, that a GEO service page appears by the next compile).
